# Biosecurity Training NZ

> New Zealand's dedicated biosecurity training resource for businesses, importers, exporters, logistics professionals, and Transitional Facility operators. Aligned with MPI (Ministry for Primary Industries) and Biosecurity New Zealand requirements.

Biosecurity Training NZ provides free online biosecurity awareness training for staff at MPI Approved Transitional Facilities, professional Accredited Person (AP) accreditation pathways via QCONZ, and plain-English guides to New Zealand biosecurity law and compliance.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://biosecuritytraining.nz/): Overview of all training resources and accreditation pathways
- [Training Courses](https://biosecuritytraining.nz/training.html): Free TF staff training and MPI-approved AP training via QCONZ
- [What is a Transitional Facility in New Zealand?](https://biosecuritytraining.nz/articles/what-is-a-transitional-facility-in-new-zealand.html): TFGen standard, Operating Manual requirement, operator training obligations
- [What is an Accredited Person (AP) in New Zealand?](https://biosecuritytraining.nz/articles/what-is-an-accredited-person-ap-new-zealand.html): AP role, which businesses need one, how to become one
- [NZ Biosecurity: What Every Business Needs to Know](https://biosecuritytraining.nz/articles/nz-biosecurity-what-every-business-needs-to-know.html): Business obligations under the Biosecurity Act 1993
- [Site Access Management for MPI Approved Transitional Facilities](https://biosecuritytraining.nz/articles/site-access-management-for-transitional-facilities-sitekey.html): Managing contractor and visitor access at TF sites
- [Forklift Safety in NZ Warehouses](https://biosecuritytraining.nz/articles/forklift-safety-awareness-warehouse-teams-nz.html): Forklift awareness training for warehouse, distribution, and Transitional Facility teams who work on foot near forklifts
- [The QCONZ AP Biosecurity Training Course](https://biosecuritytraining.nz/articles/qconz-ap-biosecurity-training-course.html): MPI-approved AP training for sea container handling
- [What is the Biosecurity Business Pledge?](https://biosecuritytraining.nz/articles/what-is-the-biosecurity-business-pledge.html): The NZ Biosecurity Business Pledge commitment
- [Which Biosecurity Training Do You Need?](https://biosecuritytraining.nz/articles/which-biosecurity-training-do-you-need.html): Awareness, Accredited Person and Transitional Facility Operator training compared, so you can pick the right MPI training for a role

## Freight, Logistics and Careers

- [Start Your Career in Freight, Logistics and Biosecurity](https://biosecuritytraining.nz/start-your-career.html): Entry points into New Zealand freight, logistics and biosecurity work, and the free training that starts you off
- [What Does a Freight Forwarder Actually Do?](https://biosecuritytraining.nz/articles/what-does-a-freight-forwarder-do-nz.html): The eight things a freight forwarder handles, why they rarely own the transport, and the NZ rules they work within
- [Freight Forwarder vs Customs Broker vs 3PL: Who Does What?](https://biosecuritytraining.nz/articles/freight-forwarder-vs-customs-broker-vs-3pl.html): The difference between the three roles on a New Zealand import, the Trade Single Window, duty and GST, and who is responsible when the paperwork is wrong
- [How to Start a Career in Freight Forwarding in New Zealand](https://biosecuritytraining.nz/articles/how-to-start-a-career-in-freight-forwarding-new-zealand.html): Entry-level roles, what employers look for, and how to get in without a degree
- [Import Pathway Careers in New Zealand](https://biosecuritytraining.nz/articles/import-pathway-careers-new-zealand.html): The jobs along the import chain, from shipping and forwarding to customs, warehousing and distribution

## Interactive Tools

- [Border Watch: The Unwanted 12](https://biosecuritytraining.nz/unwanted-pests-challenge.html): A free browser game and 60-second video briefing covering the twelve highest-risk pests and diseases New Zealand works to keep out, with the reporting number 0800 80 99 66
- [Import Pathway Career Explorer](https://biosecuritytraining.nz/import-pathway-explorer.html): An interactive walk through a real New Zealand import, meeting every role from shipping line and freight forwarder to customs broker, MPI biosecurity, warehouse and retailer

## Key Facts

- Training provider: Capability Solutions (train.capabilitysolutions.co.nz)
- Regulatory authority: Ministry for Primary Industries (MPI), New Zealand
- Primary legislation: Biosecurity Act 1993
- Primary facility standard: TFGen (Transitional Facilities for General Uncleared Risk Goods), current version 2 October 2025
- AP training delivered by: QCONZ (biosecuritytraining.qconz.co.nz)
- Free awareness training: Available for all TF staff at no cost
- Reporting suspected biosecurity risk in New Zealand: 0800 80 99 66 (Biosecurity New Zealand exotic pest and disease hotline)
- Site coverage: biosecurity compliance, Transitional Facility operation, and careers across the New Zealand import pathway
- Paid accreditation: QCONZ AP course (MPI-approved)
- Content authored by: Gordon Findlay, Findlay and Co (Capability Solutions)
- Last updated: 2026-08-16
